scope: Loss-free measurement range only. Long RX holds are complete read-to-NACK pairs >=26656301 cycles. Service is worker RX descriptor to TX commit, not E2E. PPVID decoding is established; equality to Linux CPU number is supported by these observations, not independently calibrated here.

import sys,json,pathlib,collections,bisect
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/enzian')
import analyze_rx_holds as h
import eci_state_output as e
p=pathlib.Path('out/board/hol-516112-boot02-three-retry/trace/measurement-range.bin');m=e.enrich_trace_map(h.dma.load_map(pathlib.Path('out/ci-followup/516112/hardware/lauberhorn_trace_dma_map.json')))
r=sorted(h.read_records(p,m),key=lambda x:x[0]);pending={};active={};holds=[];services=[];incomplete=collections.Counter()
for t,n,f in r:
 c=f.get('CoreID')
 if n=='Lost':assert not f['count']
 if not c:continue
 if n in ('EciRxReadFirst','EciRxReadNew'):
  if c in pending:incomplete['replaced_read']+=1
  pending[c]=t
 if n in ('EciRxDescSent','EciRxNackSent'):
  a=pending.pop(c,None)
  if a is not None and n=='EciRxNackSent' and t-a>=26656301:holds.append(dict(core=c,start=a,end=t))
 if n=='EciRxDescSent':
  if c in active:incomplete['replaced_descriptor']+=1
  active[c]=t
 if n=='EciTxCommitRead' and c in active:services.append(dict(core=c,start=active.pop(c),end=t))
g=[]
for _,sample in h.dma.iter_sample_range(p,m,0):
 source=h.dma.sample_source(sample,m);info=h.dma.source_info(m,source)
 if not info.get('channel','').startswith('gsync_req'):continue
 payload=h.dma.sample_payload(sample,m)
 if not e._is_accepted_eci_payload(payload,m):continue
 t=h.dma.adjust_timestamp(h.dma.raw_sample_timestamp(sample,m),sample,m)
 g.append(dict(cycle=t,channel=info['channel'],header=hex(e._field(payload,m,'eci_header'))))
g.sort(key=lambda x:x['cycle']);services.sort(key=lambda x:x['start']);starts=[x['start'] for x in services]
for v in g:
 t=v['cycle'];v['holds']=[dict(core=x['core'],remaining_us=(x['end']-t)/200,end=x['end']) for x in holds if x['start']<=t<x['end']]
 v['active_services']=[dict(core=x['core'],duration_us=(x['end']-x['start'])/200,commit_after_gsync_us=(x['end']-t)/200) for x in services if x['start']<=t<x['end']]
 end=max((x['end'] for x in v['holds']),default=t)
 upcoming=services[bisect.bisect_left(starts,t):bisect.bisect_left(starts,end)]
 good=[x for x in upcoming if x['end']<end and any(y['core']!=x['core'] and y['end']>x['end'] for y in v['holds'])]
 v['completed_new_services_before_peer_release']=len(good)
 v['first_new_service']=dict(good[0],duration_us=(good[0]['end']-good[0]['start'])/200,start_after_gsync_us=(good[0]['start']-t)/200) if good else None
summary=dict(gsync_requests=len(g),with_long_peer_hold=sum(bool(x['holds']) for x in g),with_active_service=sum(bool(x['active_services']) for x in g),active_service_cases=[x for x in g if x['active_services']],with_new_service_before_peer_release=sum(bool(x['completed_new_services_before_peer_release']) for x in g),incomplete=dict(incomplete),service_count=len(services),hold_count=len(holds))
pathlib.Path('out/benchmark-four-worker-20261004/gsync-negative-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(summary=summary,events=g),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
print('NEGATIVE_EXAMPLES',json.dumps([x for x in g if x['completed_new_services_before_peer_release'] and not x['active_services']][:3],indent=2))
